ANM-30.where: anim.client.js:78 cycle (Page Up / Page Down, Previous / Next)
ANM-30.note: SOEdit is wrong here: names compared with / only, so a backslash path jumped to the first or last file, and it saved before switching. Here paths are normalised and compared without case, and switching loses nothing because changes stay in the document until save. It cycles the animations the document has open (the model's sequences plus any read in), not every .anm on disk in the folder.
